Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 3951 West Washington Boulevard, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: §_M1-1 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District
Lot Area: 12,400 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a zoning change to permit a new three (3) pump
gas station (6 fueling positions) and a one-story accessory retail
convenience store building at the subject property. Off-street parking for
two (2) cars will be provided. The proposed retail convenience store
building will be 24 ft.-4 in. in height and contain 2,112 sq. ft. of total floor
area. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment
and Variation of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking
all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for
the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 2,112 square feet (0.17 FAR)

(B) | The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): No dwelling units proposed.

© The amount of off-street parking: 2

(D) Setbacks:
a Front Setback: 75 feet-9 inches
b. Side Setbacks:
West Side: 1 feet
East Side: 34 feet-11 inches
Gs Rear Setback: zero

(E) Building Height: 24 feet-4 inches
